design_brief: Optional small light for varied workspaces; no collision or new desk base.
gameplay_scope: Approved passive host-overlay art only; no runtime/default-layout binding, powered-light system, switch, interaction, service action, new host adaptation, actor behavior, worker authority, persistence or gameplay transaction.

current_availability.direction_art_review: Approved as exact desk-lamp-kit-v2 passive art only after native and 4x review on the accepted workstation in N/E/S/W. The independently authored rear shade/support and front base/lip overlays share the 192×224 host canvas and [96,160] pivot, add zero collision, clear all twelve direction-by-device checks and remain fully visible at z+2/z+4 above the host top. Export 112/0, final shared structural 412/0 and isolated actual-GameMain 67/0 checks pass; the main-agent rubric is 3/2/2/3/3/3 (2.67). Honest actor intersection is 0/2/0/0 because the lamp occupies clear edge space. No glow, switch, service, runtime binding or second-host adaptation is approved.

previous_catalogue_availability.direction_art_review: No finished art or runtime family is claimed for this proposal; unrelated concept/source art may exist.

superseded_v1_art_proposal.reason: The v1 South rear overlay sat behind the accepted desk top, leaving detached fragments while its green shade was hidden. Its files and evidence remain preserved and are not relabeled as approved art.

native_geometry.anchor_rule: One unchanged canvas coordinate represents local floor pivot [0,0] in every direction and every layer. Transparent padding is not sprite scaling.
native_geometry.host_rule: Primary-host export shares the host canvas and floor anchor; zero new floor collision. A second host requires an explicitly reviewed socket adaptation, not runtime downscaling.

layers.note: Optional ambient/glow overlay is absent and unclaimed; passive art approval does not create a powered state.

variants.redraw_requirement: Author this view in the same top-down/front-elevation projection. Do not rotate the complete bitmap; do not count a mirrored image as accepted without a direction and lighting review.
